scenarios.name: Engine-only behavioral change
scenarios.description: A change is made only within an engine module (e.g., behaviour_engine utils.py)
invalidated_evidence: C42.26 behaviour_engine mutation evidence
C43 strengthening evidence for behaviour_engine
scenarios.planned_execution: Targeted mutation run on behaviour_engine only
scenarios.diagnosis: EvidenceAwarePlanner selects behaviour_engine as sole affected component
scenarios.strengthening: If new survivors appear, classify and propose tests per C44 strengthening protocol
scenarios.certification: Revalidation required for affected component only

scenarios.name: Service-only behavioral change
scenarios.description: A change is made only within a service module (e.g., transaction_intelligence_service.py)
scenarios.affected_component: transaction_intelligence (service layer not in mutation scope)
invalidated_evidence: API contract evidence for transaction-intelligence endpoints
scenarios.planned_execution: API contract revalidation + targeted unit tests
scenarios.diagnosis: Service changes may affect API contracts but not engine mutation scores
scenarios.strengthening: Contract tests may need strengthening if API behavior changes
scenarios.certification: Revalidation required for API contracts; engine evidence reused

scenarios.name: Common utility change affecting a capability
scenarios.description: A change is made in common/calculations.py affecting multiple engines
invalidated_evidence: All component evidence using common calculations (all 14 components)
reused_evidence: None — shared infrastructure change invalidates all dependent evidence
scenarios.planned_execution: Full 14-component campaign (shared:: mechanism triggers repo-wide revalidation)
scenarios.diagnosis: Shared infrastructure change requires evidence-aware planner to mark all dependent components as affected
scenarios.strengthening: All components may need strengthening if new survivors appear
scenarios.certification: Full campaign required; no evidence reuse

scenarios.name: Mapper/API change
scenarios.description: A change is made in a mapper or router module
invalidated_evidence: API contract evidence
wire compatibility evidence
scenarios.diagnosis: Mapper/router changes affect API contracts but not engine behavior
scenarios.strengthening: Contract tests may need strengthening if DTO mapping changes
scenarios.certification: Revalidation required for API contracts; engine evidence reused

scenarios.name: Cross-component capability change
scenarios.description: A change spans multiple components within one capability (e.g., loan_engine + loan_service)
invalidated_evidence: loan_engine mutation evidence
API contract evidence for /loans
scenarios.planned_execution: Targeted mutation run on loan_engine + API contract revalidation
scenarios.diagnosis: Evidence-aware planner selects loan_engine + loan API contracts as affected
scenarios.strengthening: New survivors in loan_engine classified and strengthened
scenarios.certification: Revalidation required for loan_engine and loan API contracts

scenarios.name: Cross-capability dependency change
scenarios.description: A change in one capability affects another capability through shared dependencies
invalidated_evidence: financial_intelligence mutation evidence
loan_engine mutation evidence
transaction_intelligence mutation evidence
scenarios.planned_execution: Targeted runs on affected components + cross-capability regression tests
scenarios.diagnosis: Evidence-aware planner traces dependency graph and selects all affected components
scenarios.strengthening: New survivors in any affected component classified and strengthened
scenarios.certification: Revalidation required for all affected components

scenarios.name: Test-only change
scenarios.description: A change is made only in test files (no production code change)
invalidated_evidence: None — test-only changes do not invalidate production evidence
scenarios.planned_execution: Full test suite run (regression check only)
scenarios.actual_execution: N/A — test-only changes follow standard PR process
scenarios.diagnosis: Evidence reuse policy: test-only changes do not trigger evidence invalidation
scenarios.certification: No revalidation required; standard test pass sufficient

scenarios.name: Configuration change
scenarios.description: A change is made in configuration files (pyproject.toml, .coveragerc, etc.)
invalidated_evidence: Coverage evidence if source scope changes
Mutation evidence if configuration changes
reused_evidence: All evidence from previous runs with same configuration
scenarios.planned_execution: Re-run affected verification profiles with new configuration
scenarios.diagnosis: Configuration changes may affect measurement scope but not production behavior
scenarios.certification: Revalidation required for affected measurement scope

scenarios.name: Equivalent mutant
scenarios.description: A surviving mutant is classified as equivalent (Class-B)
invalidated_evidence: None — equivalent mutants do not represent behavioral gaps
scenarios.planned_execution: No test generation; document and classify
scenarios.actual_execution: C42.17 classification for account_engine, credit_card_engine, loan_engine, reconciliation_engine
scenarios.diagnosis: Equivalent mutants are not killed because they do not represent observable behavioral differences
scenarios.certification: Equivalent mutants remain classified; no evidence invalidation

scenarios.name: Defensive/unreachable mutant
scenarios.description: A surviving mutant is in defensive/unreachable code (Class-C)
invalidated_evidence: None — unreachable code does not affect behavioral evidence
scenarios.planned_execution: Document as unreachable; no test generation
scenarios.actual_execution: C42.25 inventory documented TXN-C1, TXN-C2, FIN-E2 as unreachable
scenarios.diagnosis: Defensive/unreachable code is not part of executable behavioral surface
scenarios.strengthening: No test generated (unreachable code cannot be meaningfully tested)
scenarios.certification: Unreachable code documented; no evidence invalidation

scenarios.name: Genuine behavioral survivor
scenarios.description: A surviving mutant represents a genuine behavioral gap (Class-A)
invalidated_evidence: None — genuine gaps indicate missing tests, not invalid evidence
scenarios.planned_execution: Evidence-driven test strengthening per C44 protocol
scenarios.diagnosis: Class-A survivors indicate tests execute but do not assert meaningful behavior
scenarios.strengthening: Generate capability-aware test proposals; validate via targeted mutation; human authorization required

scenarios.name: Ambiguous behavioral survivor
scenarios.description: A surviving mutant's expected behavior is ambiguous (Class-E ambiguity)
invalidated_evidence: None — ambiguity is a design/contract issue, not an evidence issue
scenarios.planned_execution: Document as AMBIGUOUS_BEHAVIOR; human review required
scenarios.actual_execution: C42.25 documented TXN-E1 (fee calculation ambiguity) and FIN-E1 (FOIR impossible condition)
scenarios.diagnosis: Ambiguous behavior cannot be resolved by test generation alone
scenarios.strengthening: No test generated; document and escalate to human review

scenarios.name: Shared infrastructure change
scenarios.description: A change is made in shared infrastructure (common/, core/domain/)
affected_capabilities: all capabilities using the shared module
invalidated_evidence: All evidence from components using the shared module
reused_evidence: Evidence from components NOT using the changed shared module
scenarios.planned_execution: Full campaign or targeted runs on all affected components
scenarios.diagnosis: Shared infrastructure changes have the widest blast radius
scenarios.strengthening: All affected components may need strengthening
scenarios.certification: Full campaign or comprehensive targeted revalidation required

scenarios.name: New capability admission
scenarios.description: A new capability is added to the repository
invalidated_evidence: None — new capability has no prior evidence
scenarios.actual_execution: N/A — no new capabilities added in C44
scenarios.diagnosis: New capabilities require baseline mutation measurement and evidence establishment
scenarios.strengthening: Initial test suite must demonstrate behavioral discrimination
scenarios.certification: New capability enters verification graph with baseline evidence
